Plus, with our proprietary "Newbie to Novice" coaching program, you won't be sitting there wondering what to do when you graduate. Let's face it. For the majority of people that make their first jump, this is simply a box that needs to be checked on their bucket list. A tandem skydive gives people the best, fastest and safest method of making their first jump. Doing a tandem jump allows first-time jumpers to experience freefall, which is the essence of our sport.
